name: Idle
description: customizes maintenance-mode appearance and simplifies toggling maintenance mode.
project_description:

 The module introduces changes to the standard maintenance mode by replacing the default maintenance page with a television-style design featuring colorful test bars and a central message. The message displayed on this page is dynamically sourced from the standard maintenance mode settings. To modify these settings, administrators must temporarily disable the module.

 Features 
 
 Custom maintenance page 
Replaces the default maintenance page with a distinctive design inspired by retro television test screens. It features colorful bars and a central message dynamically pulled from the existing maintenance settings. 
 Streamlined maintenance toggle 
Allows administrators to enable or disable maintenance mode with a single click on a menu item, removing the need to visit the settings page and manage checkboxes.
